regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the source-derived title and aggregate Co-catalyzed hydride-free photoredox reduction claim. The abstract is a summary and does not define separate experiment rows.

regions.region: page 1 two-column Introduction and prior hydride/Ni-photoredox discussion
regions.finding: Classified metal-hydride reductions and Amgoune's Ni/ligand photoredox strategy as cited prior classes, and the authors' Co strategy as the current generic reaction class. External cited work was not promoted to current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right beginning of Results and Discussion
regions.finding: The text introduces the five leaving-group substrates 1a–1e; the actual Table 1 rows and yields are on page 2 and were recorded separately.

unresolved: The generic/prior structures use R/LG groups and do not define unique molecules or experiment-specific conditions.
The publisher advertises SI, but workspace association is unestablished.

regions.finding: Visually separated cited Pd/Cu hydride reduction, cited Ni/L photoredox reduction, and the current generic Co/PC strategy. These general/prior arrows were not assigned Table 1 or scope yields.

regions.region: page 2 center Table 1 reaction header and five LG columns
regions.finding: Recorded all five leaving-group experiments independently: OBoc 75%, OAc 36%, OBz 54%, OCOC6F5 41%, and OH marked NR. Shared Co(acac)2/PC-1/DIPEA/acetone/Blue-LED conditions were applied without inventing time or temperature.

regions.region: page 2 lower two-column optimization and initial scope narrative
regions.finding: Mapped Table 1 prose to its rows, linked the Table 2 PC-3 statement to the page-3 rows, and linked the stated isolated 91% model product to the page-4 2a scope record. The prose's 'entry 15' attribution conflicts with the page-3 table and remains unresolved.

unresolved: Table 1 omits absolute charges, solvent volume, temperature, time, LED wavelength, workup, purification, and yield basis.
Source numbering conflict: prose calls PC-3/90% entry 15, but Table 2 shows it at entry 12 and PC-6/<10% at entry 15.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 2 reaction drawing, photocatalyst structures, entries 1–17, and footnote a
regions.finding: Recorded all 17 optimization rows independently with exact 1a/Co/PC/DIPEA/solvent quantities, row catalyst/PC/solvent identities, room temperature, 405 nm Blue LEDs, 12 h, and crude-1H-NMR outcomes. ND, en dashes, and <10% were preserved as printed.
Linked the narrative product classes 2k–2y to their individual page-4 scope rows, including the 46–96% narrative range without creating an aggregate duplicate experiment.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right dialkyl limitation and scale-up discussion
regions.finding: Linked 2z–2bb and the fully aliphatic failed example to page-4 rows, and linked the separate gram-scale 1r→2r experiment. No exact gram-scale starting amount was inferred.

unresolved: The Table 2 prose/table entry-number conflict remains unresolved.
Most scope rows lack row-specific yield bases, workups, purifications, and isolated masses.
The gram-scale starting charge/denominator is not printed.

regions.region: page 4 upper Scheme 2 full product grid and failed-example box
regions.finding: Recorded 28 successful scope products 2a–2bb and one explicit fully aliphatic failed substrate. Each row retains its displayed yield or >99% bound and shared exact reaction charges/405 nm/12 h conditions.

Recorded the independent 1r→2r gram-scale synthesis with Co(acac)2 10 mol%, PC-3 2 mol%, DIPEA 1.5 equiv, acetone, room temperature, Blue LEDs, and 2r 924.6 mg/90%. Unprinted starting scale and time remain missing.

Linked acetone-d6 13%D, DIPEA omission, CD3OD labeling, and TEMPO inhibition statements to the four Scheme 4 arrows on page 5. The narrative gives 37%D for CD3OD, conflicting with the figure's 34%D; both are retained.

unresolved: Most scope rows do not print row-specific workup, purification, isolated mass, or yield basis.
CD3OD control conflict: page-4 prose gives 37%D while page-5 Scheme 4 gives 34%D.

regions.finding: Recorded four distinct experiments: acetone-d6 gives 2u 77%/13%D; no DIPEA gives NR; CD3OD 10 equiv gives 2r 80%/34%D in the figure (37%D in prose); TEMPO 2 equiv gives 2u <5% and GC-MS-detected adduct 3 with printed m/z values.
Classified Co(I), int-I/int-II, A–C, photoredox and protonation steps as one proposed mechanism rather than preparations of the intermediates.

Linked the TEMPO and GC-MS observations to Scheme 4 eq 4 and recorded the separate Stern-Volmer DIPEA-quenching experiment. The prose cross-reference to eq 4 is ambiguous because the visible arrow is the TEMPO control, not a fluorescence plot.

unresolved: CD3OD deuterium incorporation differs between prose (37%) and figure (34%).
TEMPO is described as complete inhibition while the figure reports <5% 2u.
Stern-Volmer concentrations, fit, settings, and quenching constant are not printed, and its eq-4 cross-reference is ambiguous.
Mechanistic intermediates are proposed and unquantified.

regions.finding: The conclusion summarizes the current Co-catalyzed photoredox method and introduces no new experiment, condition, product row, or quantitative result.

regions.region: page 6 left-column acknowledgments, conflict statement, data-availability statement, and keywords
regions.finding: Administrative material only. The online Supporting Information statement does not establish workspace SI association, so no SI procedure or result was inferred.

regions.region: page 6 remaining two-column references 1–13 and manuscript dates
regions.finding: Bibliography/prior literature only. External cited papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article.

unresolved: No current-paper reaction experiment or existing-record enrichment occurs on page 6.
Referenced external experiments were not re-extracted as current-paper records.
